test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements testifies that puppetry was popular in artistic circles?

options.text: People spent a huge sum of money to see puppet shows.
Puppetry finds a mention in literature.
Puppets became more sophisticated in appearance.
Puppeteers were trained to give performances.

solution:
​The correct answer is "**Puppetry finds a mention in literature**".
